title: Run receipts
description: After every run, a pixel receipt of your run (score, time, build, day) you can save and share.

title: Rug Lord, phase two
description: Below half HP the Rug Lord pulls the rug: the floor slides and his rug pullers dash twice as often.

title: Whale sighting
description: Once per run a whale crosses the chart and drops a shower of XP candles. Chase it or stay safe.
